sections.title: Minor Requirements
sections.note: A minor in Southeast Asian Studies may be achieved by meeting these requirements: Complete at least five courses. Students normally take courses in Southeast Asian Studies bearing subject heading ASIAN or its cross-listings. Other courses with relative Southeast Asian content may also count, pending approval by the Department of Asian Studies. Typically, non-language courses are selected at the 2200-level or above. Only one Intro course may count towards the minor (ASIAN 2208 Introduction to Southeast Asia). The following courses may also count towards the minor: two courses (of at least three credits each) in a Southeast Asian language at the 1100-level or above and Southeast Asian graduate courses.
